verdict.rationale: The DGX B200's BMC offers both a web UI and programmatic interfaces (Redfish, IPMI, SNMP). Command-line health checks and nvidia-smi also give scriptable access to system and GPU state, so a UI and API exist side by side. Nothing documents that the API covers everything the UI does, and the probe found no published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity, a published API reference or OpenAPI spec for the management surface, and hands-on confirmation that all UI actions are scriptable.
